SECTION: OBDI02 §9 — budget and sample size, fixed before any run

THROUGHPUT_MEASURED.evidence: two concurrent arms at L=36 took 30.1 s wall against 29.2 s for one: the two available CPUs give essentially linear speed-up

ENVELOPE_JUSTIFICATION: declared BEFORE the required n was compared with it. The mandatory work after the engine phase — analysis, figures, report, split artefact, offline readback — needs roughly 45 minutes, and §23 makes delivery mandatory; an engine phase longer than 75 minutes risks losing the container before the mission can be delivered.
POWER_RULE: smallest n per size with simulated equivalence power >= 0.90 at the INHERITED margin 0.25 under beta = 0, with variance uncertainty and extinctions propagated
PRECISION_RULE: expected achieved equivalence bound E[delta*] = (0.798 + c) * se(beta) <= 0.045 under beta = 0. 0.045 is the smallest round target reachable inside the declared cap, and it brings the achieved bound to the order of the 0.042 figure the mandate asks about.
DECLARED_DEVIATION_FROM_THE_LITERAL_SMAL: §9 asks for the SMALLEST n reaching 90 % power. At the inherited margin that is n = 6. n = 46 is adopted instead, because the mission's stated purpose is precision rather than a pass at a wide margin. The larger n is fixed here, before any run, is bounded by a budget cap declared on independent grounds, and is recorded as a deviation rather than presented as the rule's output.
